name: Nextcloud
label: Nextcloud WebDAV + OCS
description: Nextcloud WebDAV + OCS. Official API https://docs.nextcloud.com/server/stable/developer_manual/client_apis/WebDAV/index.html. One node; pick operation. Downloaded payloads may appear as OUTPUT file. baseUrl is config base_url. Handler: OfficialApiNode + api_spec.json. Self-hosted AGPL server. Use app passwords, not the account password. Set base_url to the real origin.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation fields. Do not put secrets on this port. File bytes are type file.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Overrides config operation. Accepted: copy_file, delete_file, download, move_file, share_file, upload, copy_folder, create_folder, delete_folder, list_folder, move_folder, share_folder, user_invite, user_get, user_list, user_update, user_delete.

schema.label: path
schema.description: WebDAV path under /remote.php/dav/files/{username}/. Used by file/folder ops and OCS share path. Example: Documents/notes.md.

schema.label: file
schema.description: File bytes for upload. Platform file list. Sent as the raw PUT body.

schema.label: destination
schema.description: WebDAV Destination header for copy_file, move_file, copy_folder, move_folder. Absolute URL, e.g. https://cloud.example/remote.php/dav/files/ada/Archive/notes.md.

schema.label: key
schema.description: Object key.

schema.label: format
schema.description: OCS response format. EXACT: json | xml. Example: json.

schema.label: shareType
schema.description: OCS shareType for share_file / share_folder. EXACT: 0 user | 1 group | 3 public link | 4 email | 7 circle | 10 talk. Example: 3.

schema.label: Share Type
schema.description: OCS shareType (0=user,1=group,3=public link,…). Alias of shareType. share_file/share_folder.

schema.label: shareWith
schema.description: Share target (user id, group id, or email) for shareType 0/1/4. Omit for public link (3).

schema.label: Share With
schema.description: OCS shareWith (user/group id). Alias of shareWith. Required for user/group shares.

schema.label: permissions
schema.description: OCS share permissions bitmask for share_file. 1 read, 2 update, 4 create, 8 delete, 16 share. Example: 1.

schema.label: userid
schema.description: URL path/request-body parameter `userid` for operations: user_invite, user_get, user_update, user_delete. Required by: user_get, user_update, user_delete.

schema.label: User Id
schema.description: OCS userid for user_get/update/delete/invite. Path /cloud/users/{user_id}.

schema.label: password
schema.description: Request-body parameter `password` for operation: user_invite.

schema.label: displayName
schema.description: Request-body parameter `displayName` for operation: user_invite.

schema.label: search
schema.description: Query-string parameter `search` for operation: user_list.

schema.label: value
schema.description: Request-body parameter `value` for operation: user_update.

schema.label: Email
schema.description: Email for user_invite when password is empty (OCS users). Example: user@example.com.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success {status, http_status, data, file?}. Secrets redacted. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: status
schema.description: ok on success.

schema.label: http_status
schema.description: Upstream HTTP status.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body or text.

schema.label: file
schema.description: Downloaded or converted bytes. Platform file ref-id (sq-file: / sq-ref:gridfs:). Never inline bytes or base64 as the stored type.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Official HTTP verb for this invoke. listen/webhook_listen are ingress — use a BPMN message event.

configurationParameters.label: App Password
configurationParameters.description: Nextcloud app password (not the account password). StudioQuack secret binding. Never log.

configurationParameters.label: Base Url
configurationParameters.description: Nextcloud origin (https://cloud.example.com). Interpolated as api_spec baseUrl. Required.

configurationParameters.label: Username
configurationParameters.description: Nextcloud username for WebDAV path and Basic auth.

configurationParameters.label: Email
configurationParameters.description: Email for user_invite when password is empty.
